title: Janas: Run LLMs larger than RAM by streaming experts from SSD
hook_text: Run huge AI on tiny RAM
script:
Prabanta Dey released Janas to bypass your computer's memory limits.
Your next AI project might finally fit on your standard laptop.
Janas streams model experts directly from your SSD instead of loading into RAM.
It uses memory mapping to access model weights stored on disk.
This method allows you to run models exceeding your physical memory capacity.
The project is available today on GitHub as an open source tool.
Janas specifically optimizes for Mixture of Experts models by loading only required parts.
Will you try running massive models on your local machine now?
